identity.feature: 18 principal spires: 12 Apostles in three quartets + 4 Evangelists + Mary + Jesus
Nativity quartet: parabolic perforated shafts, inner pair taller, four mosaic mitres
Three Nativity portal gables: Hope, Charity, Faith; central cypress tree
Latin-cross plan: five-aisled nave, transept, seven apse chapels; towers placed from traced plan
172.5m central Christ tower with four-armed cross; 138m Mary tower with twelve-ray star
Four 135m Evangelists surround the crossing, connected by bridges at 85m
Ten nave gables, five per flank, rose windows, fruit finials and seven apse pinnacles
Passion raking colonnade and severe pediment contrasts with organic Nativity
